\"Catat invoice\", \"Unggah PDF invoice\: "Catat invoice", "Unggah PDF invoice" and "Tandai terverifikasi" (manage-invoices permission; by default the Head). An invoice without a PDF is Waiting for the PDF; once the PDF is uploaded it is Waiting for verification, then Verified.
\"Tambah lisensi\", \"Catat penetapan li: "Tambah lisensi", "Catat penetapan lisensi" and "Catat pencabutan lisensi" (manage-licenses permission; by default the Head). Give or remove access in the vendor portal first, then record it here. An idle license is still held and must be removed before it goes to someone else.
\"Catat pembayaran\" (izin kelola pembay: "Catat pembayaran" (manage-payments permission; by default the Head). A partial payment makes the invoice Partly paid; the invoice is Paid (recorded) when the recorded payments cover its total. The Accurate document number is typed by hand.
Tombol hanya muncul bagi yang punya izin: Buttons appear only for those with the permission; a custom role follows its permissions, not its name. Renewal approval is not available in Workspace yet. Renewals that come near are sent as a notification and email; invoices not yet uploaded or verified as a notification. Payment is requested through Pengajuan pembayaran.
Cakupan: seluruh perusahaan (entitas And: Scope: the whole company (your entity), marketplace (Retail Commerce) included.
Cakupan: data Anda saja — pelanggan mili: Scope: your data only — your own customers. Your Accurate salesperson name is not mapped yet, so invoices under your name are not counted. Not company revenue.
Nilai per produk = bagian tiap baris fak: Value per product = each Accurate invoice line's share of its invoice DPP (before VAT; invoice discounts and fees allocated in proportion to line value), before returns, without down-payment invoices.
Jumlah terjual ditulis per satuan; satua: Quantities are shown per unit; different units are not added up. Some lines use the invoice unit because the Accurate unit ratio is not available yet.
Jumlah terjual ditulis per satuan dasar: Quantities are shown per Accurate base unit; different units are not added up.
Omzet produk = porsi DPP tiap baris fakt: Product revenue = each invoice line's share of the DPP: vouchers and invoice discounts are allocated in proportion to line value, before returns.
Nilai per baris faktur Accurate (DPP seb: Value per Accurate invoice line (DPP before returns), against the previous month.
Perkiraan margin (harga PO). Omzet = bar: Margin estimate (PO prices). Revenue = invoice lines adjusted to the invoice DPP (header discounts and fees allocated in proportion to line value), before returns, without down-payment invoices. Estimated COGS = quantity in base units × purchase price per base unit from the last PO before the sale date (before VAT, after PO discounts, from all suppliers); with no earlier PO, the next PO's price (marked). Margin % only covers revenue with a known purchase price and unit; old and new item codes are not matched.
Sebagian barang belum punya rasio satuan: Some items have no unit ratio in Accurate yet, so their quantity uses the invoice unit.

Piutang pelanggan dari faktur dan peneri: Customer receivables from Accurate invoices and receipts whose batch Sales or Retail Commerce approved; supplier payables from Accurate purchase invoices and payments whose batch the Finance Supervisor/Head approved. Payment requests are covered in the Daily work chapter.
Sumber piutang adalah batch Data Accurat: Receivables come from the Data Accurate batches of Sales and Retail Commerce. They change only after the selling division's Supervisor/Head approves the batch, not after a Finance approval. If receivables are not up to date, ask Sales or Retail Commerce whether their batch is still waiting.
Sumber utang adalah batch Data Accurate: Payables come from the Finance Data Accurate batch, approved by the Finance Supervisor/Head. "Data utang belum tersedia" means the first pull is not approved yet. A payment request's status in Workspace (Approved, Processing, Paid) does not change payables; they change when the purchase payment in Accurate arrives in the next batch.
Pemesanan ruang langsung terkonfirmasi b: A room booking is confirmed at once when the slot is free, and the room is used as scheduled: there is no key handover in the app. GA can cancel a booking when needed.
Peminjaman kendaraan baru dilakukan di T: New vehicle loans happen in TrackCar, not in Workspace, and Workspace does not sync TrackCar data. Vehicle bookings recorded before TrackCar can still be opened as history; the "Serahkan kunci" and "Terima kembali" buttons only appear on those older vehicle bookings.
Kolom \"Kondisi sumber\" menunjukkan ber: The "Kondisi sumber" column shows how long the work in its own module is past its deadline; "Status tindak lanjut" is only a note here. Marking "Selesai" does not pay, approve or close anything in the module: while the source is still late, the escalation stays. An empty queue for one filter does not mean all work is on time.
Nama, divisi, dan peran diatur oleh Admi: Name, division and role are set by the System Administrator or Super Admin and synced from Google Workspace. Contact the System Administrator or Super Admin to change them; only the Super Admin resets passwords.
